title: Comparison Results for a class of Neumann Problems of the $p$-Laplace Equation on Riemannian Manifolds
summary: We consider Neumann boundary value problems for the $p$-Laplace equation on Riemannian manifolds with nonnegative Ricci curvature. Using spherical symmetrization under appropriate constraints, we derive Talenti-type comparison results in Lorentz spaces. We further show that, in contrast to the Robin case, the Neumann setting admits weaker constraints, which yields stronger comparison principles.
